raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Physical side length of the square domain",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies a square with 36-by-36 uniform elements, but neither it nor Sec. 3.3 gives a physical side length.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit square in consistent solver units",
        "36 mm by 36 mm square, with 1 mm elements"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Out-of-plane thickness or reference depth",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The examples are described as two-dimensional, but no thickness or per-unit-depth convention is specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness in the chosen length unit",
        "Uniform thickness of 1 mm",
        "Uniform thickness of 10 mm"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Vertical position of the load in Fig. 7(a)",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 and the Fig. 7 caption say only that both designs share a loading condition. Sec. 4.1 defines 18 positions; its index 8 explicitly refers to Fig. 9 and does not identify Fig. 7(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Location index 1, at the top",
        "Location index 2",
        "Location index 3",
        "Location index 4",
        "Location index 5",
        "Location index 6",
        "Location index 7",
        "Location index 8",
        "Location index 9",
        "Location index 10",
        "Location index 11",
        "Location index 12",
        "Location index 13",
        "Location index 14",
        "Location index 15",
        "Location index 16",
        "Location index 17",
        "Location index 18, at the bottom"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Discrete force vector for the loaded patch",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies a uniform force over a 2-by-2-element area next to the right edge, but does not explain how this becomes loads on finite-element degrees of freedom.",
      "readings": [
        "Integrate a constant area-force density consistently over the four elements",
        "Assign equal vertical nodal forces to the nine vertices of the 2-by-2-element patch",
        "Represent the four force pixels by four equal nodal forces"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Magnitude of the applied vertical force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 calls the magnitude fixed, but no numerical magnitude or normalization is provided for Fig. 7(a) or the cantilever family.",
      "readings": [
        "Total downward resultant of 1 N",
        "Total downward resultant of 100 N",
        "Unit resultant in a nondimensional formulation"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Prescribed solid or void elements",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1, 3.3 and 4.1 give no passive-element mask for the conventional optimization producing Fig. 7(a).",
      "readings": [
        "All elements are designable, including those adjacent to the clamp and under the load",
        "Hold the loaded 2-by-2-element patch solid",
        "Hold a one-element-wide strip along the fixed left edge solid",
        "Hold both the load patch and the left-edge strip solid"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Physical unit of the reported solid Young's modulus",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 identifies aluminum and reports Young's modulus as 69, but the supplied text retains no unit after that number.",
      "readings": [
        "69 GPa",
        "69 in a consistently nondimensionalized stiffness system"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The paper states that the examples are two-dimensional linear problems, but does not select plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic plane stress with Poisson's ratio 0.3",
        "Isotropic plane strain with Poisson's ratio 0.3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Residual stiffness assigned to void",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (1) introduces a small void Young's modulus to avoid singularity, without assigning its value or its ratio to the solid modulus.",
      "readings": [
        "Void modulus equal to 1e-9 times the solid modulus",
        "Void modulus equal to 1e-6 times the solid modulus",
        "Void modulus equal to 1e-3 times the solid modulus"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP penalization exponent",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 specifies p greater than 1 and says it is usually 3, without explicitly assigning p for Fig. 7(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Fixed p = 3",
        "Fixed p = 2",
        "Fixed p = 4",
        "Continue p from 2 to 3 during optimization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Sensitivity-filter weights and normalization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 names a sensitivity filter and fixes its radius at four pixels, but supplies no formula for its kernel, density weighting or treatment of zero densities.",
      "readings": [
        "Density-weighted linear cone with Euclidean distance and a denominator density floor of 1e-3",
        "Density-weighted linear cone with Euclidean distance and a denominator density floor of 1e-9",
        "Normalized linear-cone averaging of sensitivities without density weighting",
        "Normalized uniform averaging over a disk of radius four pixels"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter treatment at domain boundaries",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 does not specify how the four-pixel filter operates where its neighborhood extends outside the square.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate the neighborhood at the boundary and renormalize remaining weights",
        "Use zero padding and retain the full interior normalization",
        "Reflect the field across the boundary before filtering"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Gradient terms subjected to sensitivity filtering",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 describes filtering sensitivities, while Eq. (6) contains mechanical and volume-penalty contributions; their filtering order is not stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Filter the mechanical sensitivity, then add the unfiltered volume-penalty gradient",
        "Filter the complete penalized-objective gradient"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Placement of density projection and interpretation of density",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 introduces projection without explaining its place in the update, stiffness assembly and volume calculation, or how its derivative enters optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "Project after each update and overwrite the element densities used for both stiffness and volume",
        "Keep separate design and projected physical densities, differentiate through projection, and constrain projected volume",
        "Use projected densities for stiffness but constrain the mean unprojected design density"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Projection sharpness continuation",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 fixes the initial sharpness at 1 and the threshold at 0.5, but says only that sharpness enlarges gradually.",
      "readings": [
        "Double sharpness every 25 iterations up to 8",
        "Double sharpness every 50 iterations up to 16",
        "Advance through 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 after convergence at each stage"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Volume-penalty coefficient and update",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 converts the volume-constrained problem to the penalized objective in Eq. (5), but gives no coefficient value or update rule for this example.",
      "readings": [
        "Keep the quadratic penalty coefficient at 1 in the chosen objective-energy units",
        "Keep the quadratic penalty coefficient at 1000 in the chosen objective-energy units",
        "Start at 1 and multiply by 10 every 25 iterations while the volume error exceeds 1e-3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 describes conventional optimization producing Fig. 7, but gives no initialization.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform density of 0.3",
        "Uniform density of 0.5",
        "Initially solid domain",
        "Small spatial perturbations about density 0.3, rescaled to mean 0.3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Gradient-descent step and update controls",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 identifies gradient descent as the optimization method, but gives no step length, gradient normalization, line search or move limit.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalize by the maximum absolute gradient, take a fixed step of 0.01, and clip densities to [0,1]",
        "Use Armijo backtracking with initial step 1, contraction factor 0.5 and sufficient-decrease parameter 1e-4",
        "Use an adaptive gradient-descent step with a maximum density change of 0.1 per iteration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization termination",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 says to iterate until convergence. Sec. 4.1 reports an average of 150 iterations, which does not specify a stopping rule for Fig. 7(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when maximum density change is below 1e-2 and volume error is below 1e-3",
        "Stop when maximum density change is below 1e-3 and relative objective change is below 1e-5",
        "Stop when relative objective change remains below 1e-4 for ten consecutive iterations"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finite-element interpolation and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies 36-by-36 uniform elements/pixels, but does not identify element order, quadrature or stabilization.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with full 2-by-2 Gauss integration",
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with reduced integration and hourglass stabilization",
        "Eight-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3-by-3 Gauss integration, retaining one density per cell"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Accuracy of the finite-element equilibrium solve",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The conventional FEM calculations in Secs. 3.3 and 4.1 have no stated linear-solver accuracy or residual tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Sparse direct factorization to machine precision",
        "Conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-6",
        "Conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-10"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
